summary:
A single continuous live-action shot: a pulse of warm orange light races along real power lines across rural Québec at dusk.

detailed_description:
Live-action footage shot on an ARRI Alexa 35 with Cooke anamorphic lenses: real location, practical lighting, real people, natural skin texture, real film grain, photographic realism. Light effects are subtle in-camera practical VFX integrated in the real shot. Plain clothing, phones and vehicles with no logo; no text, no letters, no numbers anywhere in the image. A straight country road in rural Québec at dusk, real wooden utility poles and sagging power lines, autumn fields, real overcast dusk light.
[Shot 1] Low tracking shot from a car window: a bright orange glint of light travels fast along the power line itself, from pole to pole, like a spark running on the wire, each insulator flashing as it passes; long exposure light trail on the wire. No text, no logos.

overall_soundscape:
Crackling electricity, whoosh of the passing poles, wind.
